title: Artificial Intelligence and the Law: Case Studies, Challenges, and Future Trends
description: Explores AI's impact on legal practice through case studies, ethical dilemmas, and future trends in automated contracts and judicial decisions.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in law, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in law for lawyers, compliance teams, policy readers, and anyone tracking legal change.
